acceptance_predicates.description: A focused fixture deterministically exits after spawn and before identity or foreground observation, and the runner captures its bounded output and exit status without a false PTY-foreground failure.
Interactive launches still require a live authenticated session leader, controlling PTY, matching foreground group, nonzero terminal size, readiness, bounded quit, and cleanup.
Successful, nonzero, malformed, and output-free fast exits are classified distinctly from a live child that failed controlling-terminal or foreground-group establishment.
No unauthenticated or reused PID is signalled, all descriptors are closed, authenticated fixture descendants are bounded and reaped, and no unrelated process is affected.
Focused adversarial tests, full project gates, independent exact-tree review, signed+DCO merge, and exact-main post-merge workflows pass.

definition_of_done: The fast noninteractive child-exit interleaving is deterministic in tests and no longer produces a false foreground-group failure.
Interactive controlling-PTY admission and authenticated cleanup remain fail-closed and fully covered.
The independently reviewed signed+DCO repair is merged and exact-main Repository Quality and Trusted Main workflows are terminal green.

inputs.description: Independent AR-1703 review evidence of two pre-execution qualification failures caused by the foreground-observation startup race.
Current asb-tui tools/run-operator-quickstart.py and its controlling-PTY contract tests.

outputs.description: A bounded qualification runner that handles legitimate fast noninteractive exits without weakening interactive PTY proof.
Focused synchronized race, identity, classification, cleanup, and interactive-preservation tests.

gates.description: Deterministic race, fast-exit classification, interactive PTY, PID identity, descriptor, descendant, and unrelated-process safety tests pass.
Formatting, lint, rustdoc, full locked tests, workflow, shell, privacy, provenance, and applicable model/source-parity checks pass.
Independent exact-tree approval, signed+DCO integration, and both exact-main post-merge workflows pass before release.
